items.title: Willie Hightower Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: The name 'Peter Boccage' is mentioned only by the [INTERVIEWER] in a visual comparison ('He looks a little bit like Peter Boccage almost'). The [INTERVIEWEE] does not mention knowing, meeting, or working with Peter Boccage, nor does he confirm the resemblance or identify the person being discussed a

ctx.x: Blue, you know like a little bit, and white shoes. Well the shoes didn't cost but 75 cents a dollar in those days, see. That white, you can be shoes, see. And the first job that we went on was in Audubon Park. And when we went up there, they had a servant to come to the door and tell us, oh my God, go to the back, don't come in the front, go around the back. And they had us to come in the back. She said, oh you like the crap and everything. The madam said she don't like so and so. Black color people come to the…
He looks a little bit like, his pictures look like Peter Boccage almost.
